content: nixpkgs vim docs + NixOS wiki (HIGH): vim-full is the configurable build (vim_configurable deprecated alias); vim-full.customize { name = 'x'; vimrcConfig.customRC = ''...''; vimrcConfig.packages.<name>.start/opt } is the mechanism for side-by-side flavors. NB: 'you must use vimrcConfig.customRC rather than installing a ~/.vimrc by hand, since the customized Vim will silently ignore any vimrc in your home directory' (NixOS wiki). NixOS/nixpkgs#301790 (2024-04, MEDIUM): vim.customize completely resets default vim config - syntax highlighting and defaults lost; use vimrcConfig.beforePlugins or add 'source /defaults.vim' (or /share/vim/vim*/defaults.vim) at the top of customRC to restore. Additive customRC assumption is wrong - customRC REPLACES. vim state files (.viminfo default /home/timbernwald/.viminfo, swap/undo/backup) are per-user shared; full XDG support is partial (vim/vim#19399) - flavors must redirect viminfofile/backupdir/undodir/directory explicitly. vimspector needs huge build with python3 -> vim-full, never plain vim.
